newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PT shares stronger on results optimism.
newsitem.headline: PT shares stronger on results optimism.

text.p: Portugal Telecom shares were stronger, buoyed by optimism over its 1996 results due on March 12 and by a stronger dollar, dealers said.
The share, adjusting to a higher close of the stock on New York stock exchange on Tuesday, was targeting an all-time high of 6,350 escudos, they said.
PT shares stood at 6,236 escudos, up 98, in volume of 71,897 at 1117 GMT.
"The prospect of better than expected results for 1996, a strong dollar, and the rise of the stock on New York stock exchange are supporting the share price," a dealer said.
Another said: "PT will attack an all-time high of 6,350 escudos and then, depending on the 1996 results, will test 6,500 escudos."
In New York on Tuesday, PT closed at $35.75, up $1.125.
